plugin.name: Standard (recommended)
plugin.description: Every archetype reaches its full spell table, gated by level and by the school skill the spell actually needs. Expert-tier spells only show up in the forties and above.

plugin.name: Vanilla+ (subtle)
plugin.description: Only the first two tiers are distributed, level floors are six levels higher and every chance is cut to 75%. Most casters will feel like vanilla for the first half of the game.

plugin.name: Ruthless
plugin.description: Level floors drop by four, chances go up by a quarter, and expert-tier spells can appear in the mid-thirties. For players who want to fear a room with two warlocks in it.

plugin.name: Restoration Self-Heal
plugin.description: Casters with Restoration 40 get Fast Healing, Restoration 60 gets Close Wounds. Fights last longer because the enemy patches itself up instead of standing in the open at 10% health.

plugin.name: Alteration Armour Spells
plugin.description: The oakflesh to ebonyflesh ladder, handed out by Alteration skill instead of by archetype, so a warlock and a shaman both get what they trained for.

plugin.name: Illusion Pressure
plugin.description: Fury, Fear and Calm for the casters whose lore supports them. Off by default: fear and calm change how a fight reads, and not everyone wants that.
